ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity (white) to 40% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central-to-distal areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation frames the trailing edges, the central notch, and the distal tips. Significant black mottling is concentrated at the interior margins of the white patches, particularly on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 2-6 pixels along the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the upper boundaries tapering into narrow, slightly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular dark pixel clusters are visible within the white pigmentation of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions are detectable across the white field of the left lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-tan discoloration on the upper margin of the right lobe's white patch.
